probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — Bug reproduced: function returned (True, None) even though subprocess exited with code 1. Spec requires (False, 'oh-my-openagent is not installed (bunx unavailable or timed out)') when the tool cannot be invoked.
trigger_summary: subprocess.run() without check=True does not raise on non-zero exit codes; when bunx exits non-zero, the function returns (True, None) instead of (False, error_message).
